rules.description: Never initialize integer tensors (like Rank, FrontNo) with torch.inf. It causes overflow/conversion errors.
torch.ceil on Python scalars behaves differently than expected in some PyTorch versions.
torch.unique(dim=0) is non-deterministic or unstable for return_inverse in some versions.
torch.cond is not fully supported in all compilation backends yet.
Crowding distance requires full population + boolean mask. Slicing population beforehand breaks index alignment.
rules.instruction: Call as `crowding_distance(objs, mask)` where mask is boolean [N]. Do not slice objs.

rules.description: Special Dominance Relationship (SDR) requires strict mutual exclusion logic for unordered pairs.
rules.instruction: Implement helper `_calculate_sdr_dominance_matrix(norm_p, theta)` using broadcasting and triu_indices.
